Draw from the skew gaussian distribution standardized to mean zero and unit variance

Source: R/simSV.R
rsn_standard.Rd

Draw from the skew gaussian distribution standardized to mean zero and unit variance

Usage

rsn_standard(n, alpha)

Arguments

n

Number of draws.

alpha

Shape parameter. Either a scalar or a vector of length n.

Value

Numeric vector of length n.
